findings.evidence: grep '^namespace|^end' Simple/Basic.lean → `end Inclusion`, `end FDRep` only; grep 'TauCeti\.(FD)?Rep\.simple_iff_isIrreducible' → 7 hits across 4 files; Values.lean:83/227 and Induction/Transitivity.lean:25/33 establish the `TauCeti.Rep`/`TauCeti.FDRep` convention.
findings.fix: Wrap the file body in `namespace TauCeti` / `end TauCeti` (keeping the inner `Rep`/`FDRep` namespaces), as `TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/CharacterTable/Values.lean` does (`namespace TauCeti` at :83, `namespace FDRep` at :227, giving `TauCeti.FDRep.isIntegral_char`). Then the docstring references resolve unchanged.
findings.issue: The file has no `namespace TauCeti` (grep for `namespace` in it returns only `end Inclusion`/`end FDRep`), so `Rep.simple_iff_isIrreducible`, `Rep.simple_of_isIrreducible`, `Rep.isIrreducible_of_simple`, `FDRep.simple_iff_isIrreducible`, `FDRep.simple_of_isIrreducible`, `FDRep.isIrreducible_of_simple` are declared in Mathlib's root namespaces. Consequently the names advertised in seven places — Basic.lean:49,51; Symmetric/Specht/Completeness.lean:209; Symmetric/Specht/Ideal/Irreducible.lean:45; CharacterTable/Completeness.lean:57,66,276 — are all dangling: there is no `TauCeti.FDRep.simple_iff_isIrreducible`.

findings.evidence: RegularIsotypicComponent.lean:100-147 states for `SimpleSubmoduleClasses`: "That this is a quotient ... is an implementation detail: build a class with `mk`, compare with `mk_eq_mk_iff`, and eliminate with `lift` ... or `ind` ... The bodies stay unexposed", and defines `mk`, `mk_eq_mk_iff`, `ind`, `lift`, `lift_mk`. Mathlib Skeletal.lean:74 `def Skeleton := InducedCategory (C := Quotient (isIsomorphicSetoid C)) C Quotient.out`; Simple.lean:68 `Simple.of_iso`.
findings.fix: Supply `SimpleFDRepClasses.mk (X : FDRep k G) [Simple X]`, `mk_eq_mk_iff` (the current `toSkeleton_eq_toSkeleton_iff_nonempty_iso`), `@[elab_as_elim] ind` (from `CategoryTheory.toSkeleton_fromSkeleton_obj`, Skeletal.lean:153), and `lift`/`@[simp] lift_mk`; define `toSimpleSubmoduleClasses` and `spechtModuleFDRepClass` through them, and drop the `Quotient.ind` uses at Completeness.lean:217,240. Also add `instance : (simpleObjects k G).IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms := ⟨fun e _ => Simple.of_iso e.symm⟩` so Mathlib's `ObjectProperty` API applies to the property this file exposes.
findings.issue: `SimpleFDRepClasses` is an `abbrev` whose body is fully exposed and whose docstring tells consumers to build with `toSkeleton ⟨X, hX⟩` and eliminate with `Quotient.ind`/`Quotient.lift`. That leaks `Skeleton`'s quotient implementation, the `FullSubcategory` `.obj`/`.property` projections, and requires `attribute [local instance] isIsomorphicSetoid` at every use site (both FDRepClasses.lean:45 and Specht/Completeness.lean add it). The sibling type in this repo does the opposite.

findings.evidence: Proof body is `rw [toSkeleton_eq_toSkeleton_iff]; exact ⟨fun ⟨e⟩ => ⟨(simpleObjects k G).ι.mapIso e⟩, fun ⟨e⟩ => ⟨ObjectProperty.isoMk _ e⟩⟩`; Mathlib's `ObjectProperty.isoMk` (ObjectProperty/FullSubcategory.lean:102) and `P.ι` are general in `P`.
findings.fix: State it as `theorem ObjectProperty.toSkeleton_eq_toSkeleton_iff_nonempty_iso {C} [Category C] (P : ObjectProperty C) {X Y : C} (hX : P X) (hY : P Y) : toSkeleton ⟨X, hX⟩ = toSkeleton ⟨Y, hY⟩ ↔ Nonempty (X ≅ Y)` and instantiate at `simpleObjects k G`.
findings.issue: `toSkeleton_eq_toSkeleton_iff_nonempty_iso` is stated only for `simpleObjects k G` in `FDRep k G`, but its proof (`P.ι.mapIso` and `ObjectProperty.isoMk`) uses nothing about simplicity, `FDRep`, or the field/monoid hypotheses — it holds for any `P : ObjectProperty C` in any category. The name is fully general while the statement is not, so a consumer with any other full subcategory cannot use it.

findings.evidence: grep 'exists_nonempty_(linear)?[Ee]quiv_spechtModule' over TauCeti/ → hits only in Completeness.lean (doc lines 52,55,208 and proof lines 163,173,183,221); no `exists_nonempty_iso_spechtModule` counterpart is stated for `FDRep`.
findings.fix: Make the two `exists_` statements `private` (they stay the proof steps for the `∃!` forms) or delete them and derive `∃` at the call sites via `.exists`, and drop them from the module docstring's Main results.
findings.issue: `exists_nonempty_linearEquiv_spechtModule` (:150) and `exists_nonempty_equiv_spechtModule` (:160) are now redundant public names: each is `(existsUnique_… ).exists` of the `∃!` form added at :171 and :180, and both are used only inside this file (grep shows no other consumer). The PR itself states only the `∃!` form for the `FDRep` reading, so the surface is inconsistent as well as duplicated.

summary: The dictionary lemmas land in Mathlib's root `Rep`/`FDRep` namespaces instead of `TauCeti.*`, so every one of the seven docstring references added by this PR names a declaration that does not exist. `SimpleFDRepClasses` also ships without the constructor/eliminator API its sibling `SimpleSubmoduleClasses` has, forcing consumers to unfold the skeleton to `Quotient`.
